messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "ask your doctor if you can keep using this medicine after 6 months of daily use"
set: ["ask your doctor if you can keep using this medicine after 6 months of daily use", "keep using this medicine even if you feel well", "keep using this medicine even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure", "ask doctor if safe to breastfeed while using medicine", "ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using this medicine", "tests can help your doctor determine if this medicine is effective", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have liver disease", "call your doctor at once if you have wheezing, choking, or other breathing problems after using this medicine", "keep using even if you feel well", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have heartburn that has lasted for over 3 months", "tell your doctor if you also use", "ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have unexplained weight loss", "ask doctor for safer medicine during this time", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are using this medicine", "ask your doctor before stopping the medicine", "ask your doctor or pharmacist if you need help"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
